title: Run the SpecSync archive gate before every CI job
description: Run the SpecSync archive gate before every CI job
no_spec_change_rationale: CI workflow ordering only; no canonical spec owns .github/workflows
acceptance_criteria: Every pull_request and push workflow (linux, pages, sculpt, trust, ui) starts with a job named Archive that runs CorvidLabs/spec-sync pinned to 106aaa43d0bcf049f19b173ddb63815a25c3f931 with archive-gate-only true, and every other job in those workflows needs it, so no other job runs while any change under .specsync/changes/ is open.
